description: This source file implements management and operations for network endpoints within a wireless device configuration system, including setting profiles, handling WPS, maintaining connection states, collecting and updating statistics, and synchronizing internal structures with a data model.

classes.name: T_EndPoint
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint including its configurations, state, statistics, and associated profiles.

classes.name: T_EndPointProfile
classes.description: Represents a network profile associated with an endpoint, including security keys, SSID, BSSID, and security mode.

classes.name: T_EndPointStats
classes.description: Contains statistical data related to an endpoint's data transmission and reception, signal quality metrics, and capabilities.

methods.name: T_EndPoint * wld_ep_fromObj(amxd_object_t * epObj)
methods.description: Converts an object to its associated endpoint structure, validating object type and location.

methods.name: lbool_t wld_endpoint_isProfileIdentical(T_EndPointProfile * currentProfile,T_EndPointProfile * newProfile)
methods.description: Compares two endpoint profiles for meaningful equivalence based on BSSID, SSID, passphrases, and security modes.

methods.name: bool wld_endpoint_isSecurityModeMloCompliant(swl_security_apMode_e secMode)
methods.description: Checks if the security mode is compatible with MLO (Multi-Link Operation) standards.

methods.name: bool wld_endpoint_isProfileMloCompliant(T_EndPointProfile * currentProfile,T_EndPointProfile * newProfile)
methods.description: Checks if the profile matches or is compatible with another profile considering BSSID, SSID, passphrases, and security modes.

methods.name: void wld_endpoint_setCurrentProfile(amxd_object_t * endpointObject,T_EndPointProfile * Profile)
methods.description: Updates the current profile of an endpoint, reconfiguring if necessary.

methods.name: syncData_Object2EndPoint
methods.description: Copies parameters from the data model object into the internal T_EndPoint structure.

methods.name: void syncData_EndPoint2OBJ(T_EndPoint * pEP)
methods.description: Updates the data model object from the internal T_EndPoint structure, reflecting current state.
